evidence_semantics.groups: Each required group is a distinct necessary fact. All required groups must be covered.
evidence_semantics.target_match: all means all listed spans contribute; any means alternative spans are sufficient.
evidence_semantics.optional: required=false provides optional context and is not required for retrieval recall.
evidence_semantics.boundary_cases: Unanswerable cases have no gold passage for the requested unsupported answer. Listed spans support only a bounded explanation.
evidence_semantics.provenance: One-based inclusive source lines and raw-file hashes at the reported commit. No generated chunk IDs.
evidence_semantics.scoring: No retrieval score or quality threshold has been established. Ambiguous and unanswerable cases primarily test behavior, not positive-answer recall.

split_policy.limitation: All cases and evidence were visible to the assistant author and are supplied to the reviewer. This is an author-visible holdout, not a blind independent test. Families are disjoint, but the small sets share source documents and related domain knowledge; do not claim statistical generalization. This version is frozen before retrieval tuning.
